output: html_document
---
```{r}
library(p8105.datasets)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
data(rest_inspec)

rest_df = rest_inspec |> 
 rename(borough = boro) |> 
  filter(
    borough != "0",
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C")
  )
```

```{r}
rest_df |> 
  filter(
    borough == "Manhattan",
    !is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude),
    latitude != 0, longitude != 0
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    text_label = str_c("Restaurant: ", dba, "\nGrade: ", grade)
  ) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~longitude, y = ~latitude, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    color = ~grade, text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.5
  )
```
